_note: One fixed monitoring workload, written down before any vendor page was opened. Monitoring pricing is unusually easy to rig because every vendor meters a different unit, so the workload is specified in units no vendor uses and then translated to each vendor's meter.
name: A small production system, monitored
assumptions: Annual-commit pricing where the vendor publishes it, because that is the number on their pricing page; the on-demand figure is recorded alongside where it differs.
One region, US. No enterprise tier, no negotiated discount, no private pricing.
Containers are counted because several vendors meter them separately from hosts; where a vendor bundles them, that is recorded rather than silently dropped.
10,000 custom metric series is the number to watch: it is the line item that is free on some plans and metered per-series on others.
Self-hosted options are excluded. Running your own Prometheus has a real cost that is mostly your time, and this compares what vendors charge, not what monitoring costs.
